source_locator.section: Houses of the Planets; footnote 49 callout and endnote
source_locator.short_quote: Mars’s day house is Aries, his night house Scorpio

normalized_rule: In Ashmand's footnote 49, attributed to Whalley and also found in modern writers, assign Mars's day house to Aries and its night house to Scorpio.
synthesis_notes: This records an editorial/modern day-night ordering, not a Ptolemaic main-text house pair or a scientific claim.
review_notes: Keep this overlay separate from the Ptolemaic two-house assignment. It is preserved because the source edition explicitly attributes the table to Whalley and modern writers.
transmission_notes: Footnote 49 explicitly says the table is from Whalley and also appears in modern astrological writers. This is editorial/modern material within the registered edition, not Ptolemy's main text.
